text: Tensifiers are Consumable Items in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be received as Division Rewards for Division activities. They can be used in battle to raise the Tension of all party members by 1,000 TP.

Taunt is a debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Similar to Lock-On in Xenoblade Chronicles, Taunt forces those afflicted with it to target the party member or enemy who used a Taunt-inflicting Battle Art. Its effect is shown as a blue line (for party member-inflicted Taunt) or a red line (for enemy-inflicted Taunt) connecting to the one who inflicted Taunt. While those afflicted with Taunt can only focus on one opponent, Battle Arts that can hit multiple opponents at once will still do so. If an ally becomes afflicted with Taunt, they will not be able to switch targets to other enemies. If an appendage is locked on to, Taunt will forcibly switch appendage lock to the main body. Terrain Immunity is a buff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants the character immunity to all terrain effects.
Tees are Casual Wear upper-body armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.
The Tactician's Eyepatch is Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
Tatty Insect Wings are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Fliers and Wisps in Colony 6, or obtained by trading.
Telethia Mirrors are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are said to show the reflection of the viewer's soul.
Telethia Rings are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various Telethia.
Telethia Stem Cells are rare materials in . They can be dropped by the Dark King Barbarus and Drakos Telethia.

Tempus Glyphs are rare materials in . It can only be obtained from Unique Monsters between levels 70 and 79. According to their description, the truth of time is inscribed on them and like every glyph, they sell for a high price on the market.

Temperantia (Japanese: , Tenperantia) is a Titan in . It serves as a demilitarized zone between the Kingdom of Uraya and the Empire of Mor Ardain. Both nations have armed garrisons stationed there, and the Ardainians have been carrying out excavations of a Judicium weapon in the area. This area is hostile and houses two Superbosses, Pernicious Benf and Tyrannotitan Kurodil. It is a barren, manta ray-like Titan, its entire landscape is extensively scarred and blackened and its waters severely poisoned and colored purple, but Temperantia still supports a wide variety of animal life and even some hardy plant life. The ancestors of the Indoline people originally lived in Temperantia at Judicium,

Talulu (Japanese: , Taruru) is an NPC in . Talulu is a Nopon who can be found at the Bower Lounge in the Argentum Trade Guild. She is involved in the quest Hide and Seek where she must be found along Aft and Snikisniki.

Tantalese are a race in . They live on the Kingdom of Tantal, on the Titan Genbu, but their ancestors came from the Kingdom of Torna. Due to the isolationist attitude of the Kingdom, many of the Tantalese have had little interaction with the other races of Alrest and have limited knowledge about the world outside of their Titan. The Tantalese, much like Ardainians and Leftherians, most resemble humans, however some appear to have distinct cross-shaped markings on their face (that may however, just be be tattoos or face paint) and the majority of them have orange or red colored hair.
Tender-Hearted Beast (Japanese: , Kaibutsu no Kokoro, Heart of the Monster) is a Blade Quest in . It can be received from Evart at the Theospiti Temple Ruins in the Kingdom of Tantal.

The Tardy Gate (Japanese: , Sarude-mon) is a landmark in . It is located in the Stomach of Uraya, above Farlaine Central Pools and Pelza's Sluice and before the Stone Gate Ruins. The water can be drained at Pelza's Sluice to reveal a Treasure Trove. There are no enemies here.

The Tamie Pillars (Japanese: , Temi Kōsekichū) are a landmark in . They are located on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, directly north of the Central Ether Boulder and south of Tirkinlandia. The pillars cannot be climbed, but are directly below the Sealed Quarry.

Tantalese Porridges are Staple Food Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Platini Deli in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
The Tatraty Deeds are deeds in . They can be purchased from Tatraty Fish in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Tantalese Velvets are Textile Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Boldarde Textiles in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Tatraty Fish is a shop in . It is run by Stullon in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. It is specialized in Seafood.
Tenne is an NPC in . Tenne is a Gormotti who can be found in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. Tenne runs a shop called Llysiau Greens specialized in Veggies.
Tatan is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya's Fonsa Myma. Tatan runs a shop called Hobby Knick-Knacks specialized in Board Games.
Tephloneo is an NPC in . Tephloneo is a Tantalese who can be found in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. Tephloneo runs a shop called Memoria Art specialized in Art.

Tantal Icecubes are Art Pouch items in . They are one of Dahlia's favorite Pouch items, and can be made using her "Icecraft Lv.3" field skill at the Dahlia's Icecraft table in Argentum's Goldmouth Warehouse.
Telen Ignas (Japanese: , Tseren Igūna) are enemies in . They are Ignas and can be found at level 72-74 in Badfella's Cave Fort in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya.

Tantalese Murals is an Info Item in . It hints at the location of the Mysterious Part C. It can be obtained by examining the mural at the top of a series of ladders in southeastern Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. The level 7 "Earth Mastery" and level 4 "Leaping" Field Skills are required to access one section, after jumping up an airflow by using level 3 "Wind Mastery" and "Leaping" Field Skills. The platform at the top is reached by climbing the ladder after using the level 7 "Earth Mastery" and level 4 "Leaping" Field Skills, then another ladder is reached to the right by jumping across a gap. The mural is located on the platform on top of this final ladder. The level 3 "Keen Eye" and "
Talmye Antiques is a shop in . It is run by Larnea and can be found in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago. It is specialized in Art.
The Talmye Deeds are Store Deeds in . They can be purchased from Talmye Antiques in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.
Talent Runners (Japanese: , Tarento Rannā) are enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 50-52 at the Bastion of Varrac on the Central Plain of Temperantia.
Tawa Ignas (Japanese: , Tauwā Igūna) are enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 48 - 50 at the Bastion of Varrac on the Central Plain of Temperantia.

Tannia Nests (Japanese: , Tania Nesuto) are enemies in . They are Skeeter Nests, and can be found at level 44-48 at the Malignant Gorge on the Central Plain of Temperantia. It summons Mishgal Skeeter by using its art "Emergence".

Tarnish Apples are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be found in the Spirit Crucible Elpys, in particular in the Vault of Heroes. One is needed during the quest Difficult Decisions.

Tender Sharks are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain, in particular from the Collection Point directly north of the locked Port Anangham gate on the Lower Level, and the one immediately west of the Fief of Forgetfulness. In the , Tender Sharks can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
Takedown (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Knuckle Claws. It inflicts Blowdown.
Tetra-Circles are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at Messet Point in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Tachyon Chips are Core Chips in . They have a 9% chance of dropping from Tyrannotitan Kurodil and can only be acquired this way, and will be dropped with 100% chance the first time Kurodil is defeated. Tachyon Chips uniquely revert a Rare Blade's weapon to its original appearance, whereas for Common and Legendary Blades it shares appearance with Dilaton Chips and Preon Chips. __TOC__
Telgoo Rapchors (Japanese: , Degure Raputa) are enemies in . They are members of the Rapchor family, and can be found at level 28-30 at the Jelidorend Highlands in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Tempest Pterix (Japanese: , Tenpesuto Puterusu) are enemies in . They are members of the Pterix family, and can be found at level 83 - 85 at the Old Industrial District in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Two of them must be defeated to unlock Corvin's level 5 Ensis Lucis Battle Skill.
Terry is an NPC in . Terry is an Urayan who can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. Terry gives the quest Family vs. Fiends.

Thanatobeast Andraz (Japanese: , Satsurikujū-ō Andorasu) is a quest-exclusive boss in . He is a member of the Behemoth family, and can be found at level 64 at the Xataris Spring in Temperantia during A Real Challenge. During the quest, it is fought twice back to back, after which it is launched away by Zenobia.

Tarun Aligos (Japanese: , Tarutan Diburo) are quest-exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Aligo family, and are found on the Isle of Terminomni in the Leftherian Archipelago during the quest Follow Your Passion.

Tataka is an NPC in . He is a Nopon and can be found on a roof overlooking the Torigoth Market in the Gormott Province. After the party raises Gormott's Development Level to 1, he will offer the Merc Mission Harvest Help. He is easily excitable and believes himself to be a Nopon scholar of a sort for his "discovery" that the Cloud Sea tides shift, hoping to be named "honorary Nopon of the year" as a result.
Tetora Lysaats (Japanese: , Tetora Shīsu) are enemies in . They are members of the Lysaat family, and can be found at level 50-54 at the Canyon of Husks in the Spirit Crucible Elpys after Salvaging.

The Tasty Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Old Routes. It enables the purchase of Tasty Kordeth Samods from the Rumbletum Canteen shop at Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Tex is an NPC in . Tex is a Phonex who can be found at the Refugee Campground in the Indoline Praetorium.
Talisandre is an NPC in . She is a Tantalese who can be found in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. She runs a shop called Lansmeyer Accessories.

Terror Smash (Japanese: , Terasumasshu) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using Rockrending Gauntlets. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Rex's Grand Smash.

Tempest Strike (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Calamity Scythe. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Mòrag's Rock Cleaver.
Tannith is an NPC in . She is a Urayan who can be found in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya. She runs a shop called Hebble Aux Cores.
Teetee is an NPC in . She is a Nopon who can be found in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya. She runs a shop called Piccaka Accessories.

Tarcah is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian inspector who can be found near the Nharil Central Plaza in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the day. He offers the Merc Mission Gondola Inspection. Tarcah can be found comforting a small Nopon girl by a streetlight. He tells the party he is surprised that intense situations have reached to Mor Ardain, initially saying that "Peace has reigned for a while now, but maybe times are starting to take a turn for the worse..."

Tank Mod is a Role CPU in . It grants Poppi a Tank role with high defenses and aggro generation. It offers a modifier that increases Tora's maximum HP stat by a percentage. It specializes in tanking damage, and can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ. Poppi α starts equipped with the rank I variant of this Role CPU by default. __TOC__

Tending to Turters is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at Sekis Pillar in the Kingdom of Tantal. It features a conversation between Nia, Zeke, and Pandoria. If the party stays at Anastatia's beforehand, Nia will indicate the existence of this Heart-to-Heart. While viewing this Heart-to-Heart is required to unlock Nia's level 3 "Sea of Plenty" Battle Skill, it will not unlock until Chapter 10 for an unknown reason, despite this Heart-to-Heart being viewable beforehand.

Tennelini is an NPC in . He is an Indoline monk who can be found inside the Sanctum of the Indoline Praetorium. He is one of several NPCs who must be spoken to as part of the quest Indol's Teachings.
Tanaris is an NPC in . He is a Tantalese who can be found at Elmos Square in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Tanini is an NPC in . Tanini can be found hiding behind some corals at the Crown of Sanctuary in the Kingdom of Uraya. Tanini is one of the Twelve Brothersisterpon.
Temimi is an NPC in . He can be found at the Nopon Workers' Quarters in the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Temimi is one of the Twelve Brothersisterpon.
The Temperantia Salvage Points are places in Temperantia in where salvaging can be performed. There are three Salvage Points in Temperantia.

Telluric Desirée is a quest-exclusive boss in . It is a member of the Mammut family, and can be found at level 84 on Merclibay Islet in the Leftherian Archipelago during the DLC Quest Merclibay's Mightiest, along with Pelagic Vincent and Celestial Bailey.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Tachyon Scarves (Japanese: , Takion Mafurā) are DLC accessories in . They extend the duration of the Break reaction by up to 64% (6.4 seconds). This effect will only apply when the wearer inflicts the reaction. They are the upgraded version of the Chrome Scarf. Unicorn Scarf and Quantum Scarf accessories. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

Syre Blants (Japanese: , Shirā Barando) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Blant family, and can be found at level 33 during the first wave of the Challenge Battle Bewitching Dance. This enemy drops no items.

Teode Skeeters (Japanese: , Teodo Sukīto) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Skeeter family fought at level 28 during the Challenge Battle Bewitching Dance. This enemy drops no items.

Temperantian Standoff is a Challenge Battle in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This challenge must be completed in order to unlock Fiora's level 3 Lacerate Blade Special. This challenge takes place near the Office Corridor in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Terror Masques (Japanese: , Senritsu no Masukarēdo) are DLC accessories in . They increase all damage dealt by up to 60%, in exchange of making the wearer take up to 30% more damage from enemies. The DLC exclusive Abyss Masque accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.
Tempest Twist (Japanese: , Fūretsu tsuisuto) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using Knives. This art recycles Zeke's Rapid Twist.

Tekuteku is a Nopon in . He is the father of Ohlala, and can be found at the Geothermal Mining Plant in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the DLC quest Search for Tekuteku, which is part of the DLC Quest Hot Spring Bonanza.

Teeco is an NPC in . She is a Tornan child who can be found at the Formide Shopping Ward in Auresco of the Kingdom of Torna. Joey is her best friend. She gives the quest Armus Gone Astray, upon completion of which Teeco and Joey's Community is gained.

The Tasteless Altar is a location in . It is located beyond the Cavern of the Seal in the Aletta Region, and is only accessible by gathering all of the Slate Pieces from around the Kingdom of Torna. The Nopon Halfsage can be found here, and will sell the locations of the four Golden Monsters of Torna. There are no enemies here.

The Tenax Ekidno (Japanese: , Tenākusu Ekidona) is a Quest Exclusive Enemy in . It is a member of the Ekidno family and can be found at level 50 at Torna's Womb in Auresco in the Kingdom of Torna. It must be defeated during Azurda SOS. As with all Quest-exclusive Enemies in , the Tenax Ekidno drops no items, only gold.

The Tacitus Urchon (Japanese: , Takitusu Unin) is a Quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Urchon family and can be found at level 20 in Gormott at Lascham Cove. It must be defeated during Salvage the Salvager. As with all Quest-exclusive Enemies in , the Tacitus Urchon drops no items, only gold.
Tawny Carrots are Vegetable collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.
Tarres's Notes are a Key Item in . They must be excavated from Torigoth Cemetery during Passing the Torch.

|-|Normal = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Terra Braids (Japanese: , Daichi no Kumihimo) are Weapon Accessories in . They can only be equipped by Lora and imbue her attacks with the Earth element. All Battle Braid weapon accessories grant Lora, Jin and Haze a Double Attack effect that give their Auto-Attacks a chance to hit the enemy twice, effectively doubling their damage and recharge bonuses. This effect is the same as Cube-type accessories and can stack with them. The likelihood of the effect triggering is based on the rarity of the accessory.

Telah Riiks (Japanese: , Tera Ratōru) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Riik family and can be found at level 23 - 28 at the Olnard's Trail in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna. Three must be killed for Minoth's level 1 Medio on his affinity chart.

Tales Rapchors are minor enemies in . They are members of the Rapchor family and can be found at level 37 - 42 at Lake Wynn in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna. Three must be defeated to unlock Minoth's level 5 Espada Blade Special.

Teppus Pippitos (Japanese: , Tenpusu Pipitto) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family and can be found at level 25 - 27 just below Golden Twin Mesa in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna.

Tarath is an NPC in . He is a Tornan soldier who can be found near the Auresco, Rear Gate in the Kingdom of Torna, and is friends with Azurda. Once spoken to he moves into Torna's Womb. He gives the quest Azurda SOS, upon completion of which his Community is gained alongside Azurda's.
Tallia is an NPC in . She is a Tantalese who is found at Elmos Square in Kingdom of Tantal.

Tei-Tei (Japanese: , Hachocho) is a Nopon in . He is a Ponspector of the yellow team met at the Navvir Crossroads on Bionis' Shoulder, appearing there only after the party first encounters Tentoo. He gives the quest Tei-Tei Lacking Charm and seeks to recover his charm from Nerthis Necropolis, an area within his purview as a Ponspector. Tei-Tei has been Ponspecting for fifteen years, but is easily distressed without his charm.
Tei-Tei's Charm is a Key Item in . It is found in Nerthis Necropolis on the Bionis' Shoulder, and is needed for Tei-Tei Lacking Charm. The party is asked by Tei-Tei to collect it.

Tei-Tei Lacking Charm (Japanese: , Hachocho no Omamori) is a quest in . It can be received from Tei-Tei at the Navvir Crossroads on Bionis' Shoulder. Completing it causes Tei-Tei to join the group of active Ponspectors.

Tentoo (Japanese: , Unini) is a Nopon in . He is a Ponspector of the blue team met outside Cragmaw Caverns on the Bionis' Shoulder, and is the only Ponspector to not give the party a quest. Tentoo has been Ponspecting for eighteen years, and is the first Ponspector encountered by the party. He can be forgetful but knows his team-mates well, and is recruited as soon as the party approach him.

Terpsichorean Cenoth (Japanese: , Yūgana Kenosu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Flamii family, and can be found at level 73 at the south shore of the Tranquil Tarn on the Bionis' Shoulder, next to Tutu's original position.

Thad is a NPC in . He can be found in Gran Dell on the Bionis' Shoulder, working behind Radzam's house. He is a Homs chef who develops a crush on Tyrea after she moves to Gran Dell. He gives the quest A Surefire Hit that must be completed before he can help in the quest Sweetest Debt. It can be noted that the quest tracker will not be able to find him during Sweetest Debt until A Surefire Hit is complete.
Taurus Arms L are heavy arms armour in . They can be bought at shops for 25,500 G.
Taurus Greaves L are heavy feet armour in . They can be bought at shops for 36,800 G.
Taurus Helms L are heavy head armour in . They can be bought at shops for 31,000 G.
Taurus Cuisses L are heavy legs armour in . They can be bought at shops for 49,800 G.
Taurus Plates L are heavy torso armour in . They can be bought at shops for 61,800 G.
Terminal Flash (Japanese: , Furasshuendo, Lit. "Flash End") is Mythra's Level III Blade Special in .
Triple SKYLLA (Japanese: ) abbreviated T-SKYLLA, is T-elos's Level III Blade Special in . T-SKYLLA is also T-elos's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .
Tainted Palace (Japanese: , Foirunisuparasuto) is Vale's Level II Blade Special in .

Tenderheart Blockers are weapons in . They are blockers wielded by Nene. They boast the highest stats in all attributes among almost all blockers, with the only exception being Snughug Blocker C, which provides 10 extra Physical Defence and 5% extra Block Rate. __TOC__

Tactical Points, commonly referred to as TP, are a mechanic in and .

The Syra Hovering Reefs (Japanese: , Shiwera Fuyū Ganshō Chitai, Shiwera Floating Reef Area) is an Area in , located in the Keves Castle Region. Colony 11 and Fort O'Virbus are located here. The remains of Mor Ardain make up this area.

Technical Heal (Japanese: , Tekunikaruhīru) is a Talent Art in . It is the Talent Art of the War Medic class. The Art provides healing to all allies, regardless of distance.

The Tengate Ruins (Japanese: , Tengeito Iseki) is a location in , located on Daedal Isle in Erythia Sea. It was formerly the Centre Gate from Eryth Sea, but with all of the transporters, including the one leading to Alcamoth, broken down. The Eternal Canopy is located here.
Thaumaturge (Japanese: , Rensei-shi) is an Agnian Healer class in .
The Terra Wastelands (Japanese: , Tera no Arechi) is a Location in , located in Ribbi Flats.

The Tableland Ferronis Hulk (Japanese: , Kōgen no Kuchita Tetsukyoshin) is a Rest Spot in . It is located on Rae-Bel Tableland. This Ferronis Hulk is rebooted by completing The Tableland Hulk, and requires 10 Ether Cylinders to reboot. The Tableland Caravan is located here.

Terrorbird Zieger (Japanese: , Osoredori no Zīgā) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Ansel family, and can be found at level 37 near Glam Rock in the Dannagh Desert. The Hawk Shot Art can be earned by the Soulhacker class for defeating it.

Tenderling Rumi (Japanese: , Itaike no Ryumii) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Armu family, and can be found at level 23 at Lisza Garden in Ribbi Flats. The Amazing Growth Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Talkative Dirakha (Japanese: , Kataribe no Dirakka) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Moglum family, and can be found at level 63 near Welkin Falls in southeast Erythia Sea. The Deeply Tactical Skill can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it. To find Talkative Dirakha, Skip Travel to the Welkin Falls Landmark and drop down the waterfall to the north. It should be right next to you when you fall.

Taskmaster Imperion (Japanese: , Shireigata Inperion) is a Unique Monster in . It is an Ulula type Agnian Levnis, and can be found at level 49 in the Erythia Relay Base in Erythia Sea. The Excessive Armor Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Thaumawolf Bajeek (Japanese: , Marō no Bajakku) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Kananus family, and can be found at level 71 at the Central Defense in the Origin Interior. The Wolf Spirit Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
Tepnos Heights (Japanese: , Tepunosu Kyūryō) is a Location in . It is located past Dies Arch on Elaice Highway.

|-|Attacker= |-|Defender= |-|Healer= Tachyon Slash (Japanese: , Takionsurasshu) is one of Noah's Arts with Lucky Seven in . In order to use this art, Noah must first use the Unlimited Sword Talent Art. When used, Noah does a slash that unleashes a flurry of energetic slashes in front of himself.
Syrup Spruces are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be produced by the Tableland Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Tezlan Skeeters are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Skeeter family, and can be found at level 17-18 in the cave connecting Caitlin Drum and the Sage's Balcony in Ribbi Flats.

Ten-Term Palms are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Tafetta Lobsters are items in . They can be produced from any Fabricator except the one at Perimeter Outlet.
Testudo Shoulder Guns are items in and . It is dropped by Testudo in the Pentelas Region and by Navigator Helios.

Tallow (Japanese: , Tarō) is a NPC in . Tallow is the new lieutenant of Colony Mu.

The Tableland Caravan is a shop in . It is run by a Traderpon and can be found at the Tableland Ferronis Hulk on Rae-Bel Tableland after completing The Tableland Hulk.
The Terrace Caravan is a shop in . It is a shop run by a Traderpon at the Seilas Terrace Camp on Rae-Bel Tableland. It sells Ether Cylinders for 10000 G.

Tattered Army Satchels are sell-only Collectible items in . They can be found in Origin.
Tamtam is a Nopon NPC in . He can be found at the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk in Erythia Sea after completing The Sandbar Hulk.

Ta-da-to Surprises are Meal items in . They can be purchased from the Colony 4 Canteen after choosing Colony 4 during the Quest: Crusader For Spuds. Doing so will lock you out of the Pon-Fried Croquettes.
Teena, also known as No. 10, is a NPC in . She is a member of Colony 0 and can be found at Li Garte Prison Camp after In Search of a Home.

Taunt Pulse is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Lost Vanguard class. In the resulting stance, the user deals 50% of Attack as damage to enemies in a fixed radius around them every second, gaining aggro every second as well as increase aggro generation by 25%.
Terror Onslaught is a Battle Art in . It is one of the arts of the Machine Assassin class.

Target Lock is a Status Effect in and . Similar to Lock-On in or Taunt in , it causes the target enemies or players to have their aggro locked to the target enemy or player. Target Lock can be resisted using the Mint Potpourri or Lavender Potpourri accessories.

Tail Slap (Japanese: , Tērubinta) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Scornful Daria while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Tephra Cavern, Reshaped (Japanese: , Kawarihateta Tefura Daikūdō-ato) is a Location in , located at The Ragmos Desolation. It is a reshaped and relocated Tephra Cavern in a cave north of the Ruined Tower Square. An Ether Lift connecting to the Oracle Spire can be built here.
The Tale of the Bringer of Chaos is a Key Item in . It is found in Raguel Lake during Lost & Found: Unread Book. It is a book about Zeke.
Tender Boiled Lobster is a Meal item in . It can be cooked at Rest Spots. It is unlocked by obtaining the Boiled Lobster Recipe.
Tactics Manual, vol. 1 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from the Relic at Gotrock Oracle Ruins, and is accessible by Field Crafting a ladder.
Tactics Manual, vol. 2 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from the Relic at the Lumos Pillar Remnants.

Tactics Manual, vol. 3 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from the Relic on the upper level path northeast of the Colony 5 Wreckage. It is accessible by building a series of Ether Slides starting from the clearing above Cryoconite Laurel.
Tactics Manual, vol. 4 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from the Relic in the Sacred Water Cavern.
Tactics Manual, vol. 6 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Sworn Protector Hector.
Tactics Manual, vol. 7 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Perambulator Moritz.
Tactics Manual, vol. 8 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Cryoconite Laurel.
Tactics Manual, vol. 9 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Smackdown Brannigan.
Tactics Manual, vol. 10 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Troglodyte Umir.
Tactics Manual, vol. 11 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Cavalier MacBright.
Tactics Manual, vol. 12 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Radicalized Godwin.
Tactics Manual, vol. 13 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Prohibitor Giuseppe.
Tactics Manual, vol. 14 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Hallowcanter Hazerune.
Tactics Manual, vol. 15 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Surrogate Fitzpatrick.
Tactics Manual, vol. 16 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Naberius Invictus.
Tactics Manual, vol. 17 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Many-Lived Derrick.
Tactics Manual, vol. 18 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Tenebrous Muramasa.
Tactics Manual, vol. 19 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Fograptor D'nari.
Tactics Manual, vol. 20 is an Accessory in . It can be obtained from Fogstalker Naiara.
Testudo Scouts are Normal Enemies in . They are two Agnian Levnises that can be found at level 37 at the Agnus Outpost at the West Planada Panorama on the Aurora Shelf.
Tenebrous Muramasa (Japanese: , Tokoyami no Muramasa) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Taos family, and can be found at level 39 on Ruined Anti-Air Battery 3 in Yesterdale at night.

The Taos Egg is a Normal Enemy in . It is an Egg that hatches into the Unique Monster Many-Lived Derrick, and can be found at level 40 above the Gelgemos Garrison at The Ragmos Desolation. When defeated, it drops rare Hard Eggshells.
Symbol Ornaments are items in . They can be dropped by Igna Symbols in Aurora Shelf.

Tantal is a Field Track from , composed by ACE. It is track seven of disc four from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track seven of disc nine from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the day on the Upper Level, Lower Level, and Head of the Kingdom of Tantal. In , parts of this song are remixed for the Xenoblade Chronicles 2 Medley.

Tensed Mind is a track from and , composed by Manami Kiyota. It is track fifteen of disc four from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track fifteen of disc nine from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the following moments in : * The flashback of the party learning of Malos's attack on Auresco. * The party's encounter with Zeke and Pandoria at Ysheva Harbor. * Rex seeing visions of Malos speaking when Amalthus talks about his journey up the World Tree. * When the party realizes that Jin and Torna are likely the cause for the attack in Temperantia. * When Raqura learns about Torna's actions and the reawakening of the Aegises at the summit in Indol. * M

That to Which the Defeated Cling is a track in and , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. Ted is a NPC in . He can be found at BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles, between the BLADE Barracks and the Mimeosome Maintenance Center alongside Eric.

Tarsus is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who appears near Nharil Central Plaza in the Empire of Mor Ardain at the beginning of Failure and Success, where he, Lant, and Renaud try to force Ellenora to pay him. He is unable to be spoken to.
Tephra Hill (Japanese: , Tefura-zaka) is a location in . It is located in Colony 9. It is a hill found just outside the Main Entrance and leads up to the Tephra Cave Entrance.

Tetsuya Takahashi (Japanese: , Takahashi Tetsuya) is a video game developer and co-founder of Monolith Soft. Before founding Monolith Soft, he worked at SquareSoft on many games, including Chrono Trigger, Final Fantasy IV, V, VI, and VII, Secret of Mana and Xenogears.

The Key to a Long Life (Japanese: , Genki no Hiketsu) is a quest in . It can be received from Dionysis southeast of the Residential District in Colony 9. If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment.

The Giants' Treasure (Japanese: , Tsuini Kyojin-zoku no Takara) is a quest in . It can be received from Kacha in the Nopon Merchant Camp of Satorl Marsh. It is the third and final quest in a series of three quests involving Kacha and the Exile Fortress. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment.
Theo (Japanese: , Tēo) is a Homs in Xenoblade Chronicles. He can be found on Digit 2 of the Fallen Arm.

Thunder Compasses (Japanese: , Sandā Konpasu) are collectables in . They are part of the Other page of the Collectopaedia, and can only be acquired by trading with Jarack in the Eryth Sea. According to their description, they are compasses favoured by adventurers and their needles look like thunderbolts. Obtaining one will unlock the "Stormy Outlook" achievement.

The Broken Watch (Japanese: , Kikai Onchi no Udedokei) is a quest in . It can be received from Désirée from the terrace north of the Commercial District of Colony 9. Shulk is required as the active party leader.

Thunder Atmoses (Japanese: , Raimei no Hemisufia, Thunder Hemisphere) are collectables in and . They can be found in Alcamoth and Colony 6. According to their description, Shulk really wanted to name them and they are half-balls that boom when thrown.

The Plan - Preparation (Japanese: , Yabō: Junbi-hen, The Ambition: Preparation) is a quest in . It can be received from Sesame in the alley southeast of the Commercial District of Colony 9, once Tephra Cave is accessible after the Mechon have attacked Colony 9. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment. Sesame first asks the party for 2 Croaking Brog Bags, then sends them to fetch a Sealed Package from Betty. It is the first in a series of three quests given by Sesame, the others being The Plan - The Night Before and The Plan - Execution.

The Plan - The Night Before (Japanese: , Yabō: Zen'ya-hen) is a quest in . It can be received from Sesame in the alley southeast of the Commercial District of Colony 9 once The Plan - Preparation has been completed. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment. Sesame first asks the party for two Iron Krabble Shells, then sends them to fetch a Fragile Package from Kenny Rohan. It is the second in a series of three quests given by Sesame. Once it is completed, The Plan - Execution may be offered.

The Plan - Execution (Japanese: , Yabō: Jikkō-hen) is a quest in . It can be received from Sesame in the alley southeast of the Commercial District of Colony 9 once The Plan - The Night Before has been completed. It is the third and final quest in a series of three quests given by Sesame. If Melia is in the active party, she will comment.

The Lost Pendant (Japanese: , Nakushita Pendanto) is a quest in . It can be received from a Defence Force soldier in the Cylinder Hangar in Colony 9 once Tephra Cave has become accessible after the Mechon attack. If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment.

This quest will expire after the decision to move to Colony 6. Thieving Monsters (Japanese: , Dorobō Monsutā) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Gorman in the Refugee Camp on Bionis' Leg. As with all the quests in the Refugee Camp, it will expire after the residents migrate to Colony 6. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment.

This quest will expire after the decision to move to Colony 6. The Greedy Monster (Japanese: , Ōgui Monsutā) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Satata near the pond outside the Refugee Camp on Bionis' Leg. As with all the quests in the Refugee Camp, it will expire after the residents migrate to Colony 6. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment.

This quest will expire once Otharon travels to Alcamoth as part of the main story when the party meets Miqol in the Hidden Machina Village. The Road Home (Japanese: , Natsukashi no Waga Machi e, To Our Dearly Missed Town) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Otharon at the main entrance to the ruined Colony 6. Upon expiration, it will then be replaced with the nearly identical quest, To Colony 6!, since they are Mutually Exclusive Quests.

The Giants' Key (Japanese: , Kyojin-zoku no Takara) is a quest in . It can be received from Kacha at the Nopon Merchant Camp in Satorl Marsh. It is the second in a series of three quests involving Kacha and the Exile Fortress. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.
Things that Hum (Japanese: , Hamingu Korekushon) is a quest in . It can be received from Tati in the Nopon Kitchen in Frontier Village. It is received automatically when Musical Genius is accepted.
Things that Rumble (Japanese: , Poppun Korekushon) is a quest in . It can be received from Tati in the Nopon Kitchen in Frontier Village. It is received automatically when Musical Genius is accepted.

The Master's Successor (Japanese: , Atotsugi Mondai) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Dobadoba after completing Secret Ingredient Hunt and Secret Innovation. He can be mainly found at the Pollen Orb Storehouse. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment. There is a choice of two routes leading next to Mutually Exclusive Quests after the events of Mechonis Core. If Gadada is chosen (A route), he will offer the quest Safer Energy. If Cherri is chosen (B route), she will offer the quest Distilling Active Ingredients.

Thick Rhana Hides are rare materials in . They can be dropped by various Rhanas in Colony 9 and Eryth Sea, or traded for with Oleksiy in Satorl Marsh during Stopping the Elopement involving Zel Argentis. According to their description, they are surprisingly tough pelts with layer upon layer of skin and fat. Three are needed for A Token of Friendship.

The Wilted Flower (Japanese: , Hana ga Karechau) is a quest in . It can be received from Rizaka at the Fallen Arm after completing the previous quest Fixing a Broken Door, near the Ether Light. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment.

The Old Soldier's Test (Japanese: , Rōhei Yān no Shiren) is a quest in . This quest can be received from Jan, who can be found training ground at the east side of the Military District in Colony 9. If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment. To make this quest available, Melia must have temporarily joined the party in Makna Forest, as well as Dionysis must be spoken to in the Residential District once Dionysis, Cheryl, and Minnie have been registered onto the Affinity Chart and Jan has got affinity for Minnie (obtainable once Colony 9 Area reaches ☆3 by talking to Jan between 9:00 and 15:00). Dionysis will ask what the party thinks of Jan's dating Minnie. Tell him that Jan is "too old f

※ After this quest is completed, Batubatu may offer another quest, With Much Gratitude. The Lost Nopon (Japanese: , Hōkōonchi Meiwaku Nopon) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Gerugu in the Traveller's Rest on Bionis' Leg. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment.

The Book of Bafalgar (Japanese: , Barufaruga no Sho) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is the first in a series of five quests that can be received from Shura in the Bafalgar Tomb in Tephra Cave. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment.

The Path of Bafalgar (Japanese: , Barufaruga no Michi) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is the third in a series of five quests that can be received from Shura in the Bafalgar Tomb in Tephra Cave.

The Coffin of Bafalgar (Japanese: , Barufaruga no Kan) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is the fourth in a series of five quests that can be received from Shura in the Bafalgar Tomb in Tephra Cave.
Thin Bloods are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from Eks and Feris in Makna Forest.

Throne Sardis (Japanese: , Surōne Sādi) are enemies in . They are members of the Sardi family, and can be found in Colony 9, in the water by Hazzai Cape and Anti-Air Battery 2, as well as the unnamed shore north of Anti-Air Battery 2. They can drop the Ancient Sardi Meat needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction.

The Blood of Bafalgar (Japanese: , Barufaruga no Chi) is a quest in . It is the second in a series of five quests that can be received from Shura in the Bafalgar Tomb in Tephra Cave. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment.
The Gratitude of Bafalgar (Japanese: , Barufaruga no Rei) is a quest in . It is the fifth and final in a series of five quests that can be received from Shura in the Bafalgar Tomb in Tephra Cave.

This quest will expire after the events at the Mechonis Core. The Deciphering Machine (Japanese: , Bunken Kaidoku Sōchi) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Ruthan south of the Imperial Palace in Alcamoth, near the pods. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment.

The Imperial Ceremony (Japanese: , Kōzoku no Gi) is a quest in . It can be received from Scarlen in the Oath Sanctuary of Satorl Marsh. Upon accepting it, Imperial Ceremony Offerings is automatically accepted and must be completed to validate the first objective. If Melia is in the active party, she will comment. The High Entia Emblem is received for completing this quest, allowing the High Entia Doors in certain locations to be opened.

The Mini Reactor (Japanese: , Kōseinō Kogata Dōryokuro Nyūshu) is a quest in . It is one of the three quests that is co-triggered upon accepting quest Stunted Growth received from Orkatix at the northeast ledge of the Hidden Machina Village from the Junks.

The Exhaust Pump (Japanese: , Kūki Asshuku Ponpu Nyūshu) is a quest in . It is one of the three quests that is co-triggered upon accepting quest Stunted Growth received from Orkatix at the northeast ledge of the Hidden Machina Village from the Junks.

The Missing Boy (Japanese: , Hanareta Te wo Mou Ichido) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Miriall after the events at the Mechonis Core. It is a search and rescue quest where the party is asked to find her friend's son, Teelan, somewhere in Alcamoth. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment.

The Ancient Ceremony (Japanese: , Kodai no Gishiki) is a Story Quest in . It is received at the Sororal Statues landmark in Satorl Marsh. Ancient Ceremony Offerings is automatically received during the course of The Ancient Ceremony story quest. The last objective of the quest involves the boss battle against the Satorl Guardian and requires to defeat it.

The Third Lung (Japanese: , Dai 3 Hai Naibu) is a location in . It is located on the lower level of the Bionis' Interior, and is one of the three Lungs in the area. It is accessed from the Terminal Trachea at the far west end of the area, which leads south from the lung to the entrance from Satorl Marsh. At the east end there is a pod of stomach acids, in which there is a geyser which takes the party up to the passage leading to Upper Trachea and the exit to Makna Forest. Next to this geyser is a Nopon, the sole NPC found in the entire area, who tells them how they can use the geyser. The first time the location is visited, it is empty, with no enemies or collectables. However, when the part

The Most Transparent Thing (Japanese: , Sekai de Ichiban Tōmeina Mono) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is part of the Mutually Exclusive Quests Miss Sweetness Showdown involving Ma'crish and Miss Sweetness Showdown involving Berryjammy. It is automatically triggered in Colony 6 once one of these mutually exclusive quests has been accepted. Regardless of who is given the Pure Ice Flower, the long term results are virtually the same, in regards to NPC affinity and what happens to Colony 6. At the end of the quest chain, the only difference between who receives the flower is the rewards.

The Only Thing I Can Do (Japanese: , Watashi ni Dekiru Yuiitsu no Koto) is a quest in . It can be received from Vidian after she is rescued from Whitewing Palace in Alcamoth during Vidian Rescue Mission. This quest is triggered after the Mechonis Core events if Believing Again had not been completed. Otherwise, I Will Never Forget You will be triggered, since both quests are mutually exclusive. If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment.

Thunder Bullet (Japanese: , Sandā Baretto) is one of Sharla's Ether arts in . Sharla fires two bullets at an enemy, inflicting electric Ether damage. In , Kino has an identical version of this art called Crackle Bullet.

※ After this quest is completed, Zilex may offer another quest. See The History of the Capital. The History of Mechonis (Japanese: , Kishinkai no Rekishi) is a Timed Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Zilex inside the Junks on the Fallen Arm. If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment.

The History of the Capital (Japanese: , Teito no Rekishi) is a Timed Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received by Zilex inside the Junks on the Fallen Arm. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.

Therapy (Japanese: , Serapī) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is given by Eleqa on the Fallen Arm. To trigger this quest, Stop the Mechon Rampage! must be completed, then Eiz must be spoken to so the first link between him and Eleqa will appear. Eleqa and Eiz are found nearby one another outside of the entrance to the Hidden Machina Village, during the day. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment.

Thunder (Japanese: , Tenrai) is one of Dunban's Ether arts in . It deals Ether damage in a cone around Dunban's back. When any of Dunban's auras are active, Thunder unleashes excess Ether and forces Daze to targets within range.

Thawing Relations (Japanese: , Sobo no Yukidoke) is a quest in . It can be received from Zukazu in the southwestern portion of the Residential District of Colony 9. This quest and A Place to Come Home to are mutually exclusive. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.

The Elite Captain's Anguish (Japanese: , Erīto Shōtaichō no Kunan) is a quest in . It can be received from Raoul at the entrance to the Military District of Colony 9. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment.
The Gem Man's Invention (Japanese: , Jemu-jiji no Hatsumei) is a quest in . It can be received from the Gem Man at his stall after the Colony 6 Reconstruction has begun.

Thick Armu Milk are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by the Armu on Bionis' Leg, and is not available for trade. According to their description, they have three times the flavour and nutrition compared to normal Armu milk. Three are needed for Cook-Off Counter Attack!.

Thick Nectars are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Leg Skeeters on Bionis' Leg and traded for in Colony 6 and on Bionis' Leg. According to their description, they are highly-concentrated aged nectars that are packed with amino acids. Four are needed for Weak Berryjammy.
Thick Shells are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Oros Krabbles and Corriente Krabbles on the Fallen Arm. They are not available for trade.
The Central Tower Barrier (Japanese: , Chūōtō no Shōheki) is a Story Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received automatically while arriving at the Tower Boarding Gate in Central Factory.

This quest will expire if the second objective of Dream of a Poet is completed instead. The Melody of Happiness (Japanese: , Kōfun no Chūnen, Exciting Middle Age) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Nic at the very southeast corner of the Colony 6. This quest and Dream of a Poet are mutually exclusive.

The Third Lung Bronchus (Japanese: , Dai 3 Hai Kikanshi) is a location in . It is located on the lower level of the Bionis' Interior, and it connects the Third Lung of Bionis to the main chamber of the interior.

The Legend of the Spider (Japanese: , Kumo ni Matsuwaru Mukashibanashi, Old Tales about Spiders) is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is located in the Bone Corridor in Tephra Cave, between Shulk and Reyn at purple affinity.

The Shimmering Marsh (Japanese: , Rinkō no Chi no Yuen) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located by the Zaldania Waterfall in Satorl Marsh, between Dunban and Shulk at green affinity. It can only be viewed at night.
The Colony Reborn (Japanese: , Umarekawaru Koronī) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located on the roof of the Reconstruction HQ in Colony 6, between Shulk and Sharla at pink affinity.
The Forefathers (Japanese: , Haientā Shiso no Zō) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located in Great Hall in Alcamoth, between Riki and Fiora at green affinity.
Those Waiting For You (Japanese: , Bokutachi no Kaeru Basho) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located on the Distant Fingertip of the Fallen Arm, between Riki and Shulk at pink affinity.

The God-Slaying Sword (神を絶ちし剣) is an Event Track in , composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 15 of disc 2 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack, and track six of disc five on the Xenoblade Definitive Edition Original Soundtrack and the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the third and final battle against Zanza, as well as during the cutscene right before it after Shulk obtains the Monado III.

The Monado Awakens (モナド発動, Monado Reacts) is an Event Track in , composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 7 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music plays in a couple cutscenes, first when Reyn attempts to wield the Monado in the Weapon Development Lab in Colony 9 but can't control it. More ominously, it later plays when the party reaches the Central Factory in the Mechonis for the second time, via the Junks, and Shulk collapses in agony, struggling with the Monado in an unprecedented manner. In , this song plays when the Junks is shot down by a black beam from Alcamoth.

The Fallen Land (堕ちた地で…, Into Deadlands...) is a Field Track in , composed and arranged by Manami Kiyota. It is track 10 of disc 4 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is heard during the day while the party is on the Fallen Arm of the Mechonis (not including the Hidden Machina Village).

The Battle is Upon Us (alternatively with the capitalization The Battle Is Upon Us in the Jukebox; 決戦前夜, The Night Before the Decisive Battle) is an Event Track in , composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 9 of disc 2 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is a heroic theme that is heard in the following cutscenes: * Kallian's Allied Force enters Sword Valley (after the party meets Vanea at the end of Mechonis Field) * The Allied Force engages the Mechon in Sword Valley (after the party enters the Agniratha Transporter) * The party makes their plans aboard Junks to infiltrate the Bionis' Interior and pursue Zanza, Dickson, Alvis and Lorithia. The way is a track in Xenoblade Chronicles X, composed by and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano with original lyrics by mpi and vocals provided by Sayulee. It is track 18 of disc two from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack, and is a vocal remix of THEMEX. This music is heard during the following cutscenes: * Elma and Lin's explanation of BLADE's duties in Chapter 3 * Reporting to Vandham in We Were Soldiers * Irina telling Elma of Marcus's death in Chapter 8 * After the downfall of the Zu Pharg in Chapter 10 * Elma and Lin explaining to Gwin the basics of fighting in Boot Camp * Elma demonstrating the recreation of real bodies in Chapter 12 * Reporting to Maurice with the decoded intel in Spy Game

The key we've lost is a track in , composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano with original lyrics by mpi and vocals provided by Mika Kobayashi. It is track one of disc three from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack. The track is split into two parts, and the track does not play whole during the game. The first half of this track is heard in the battle against the final boss. The second half is heard during any normal ground battle with Sylooth, Gularth, and enemy xenoforms and machines. This half is also heard during most boss battles of Normal and Affinity Missions that feature intelligent life. In , The key we've lost is a remix of the first part of this song.

The Celeste Three (Japanese: , Seresuto Surī) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It becomes available after Chapter 5 when the party overhears a male mechanic talking about Fosdyke; the mechanic can be found at night in the Administrative District's Hangar, next to Doug's normal hangout northwest of the Restricted Hangar Entrance, and is marked by a yellow speech balloon. The mission can then be received by talking to Fosdyke in Deliverance Park and asking him whether he is one of the Celeste Three.

The Probe-fessional (Japanese: , Kaitaku no Tebiki, The Pioneer Guide) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Kirsty on the BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District. This quest must be completed in order to start Chapter 4.
The Repair Job (Japanese: , Rin to Eruma, Lin and Elma) is an Affinity Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from the BLADE Barracks in New Los Angeles.
The Fail Parade is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a café employee and the primary destination is Noctilum.
Thirsty Edge is an Aura Art in . The user recovers HP when landing melee attacks while this aura is active.
Third Eye is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Commando at rank 8.

The Skell License (Japanese: , Dōru Raisensu) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from Vandham in the BLADE Barracks upon completion of Chapter 6. The party must pass each Division's Proficiency Exam, each of which rewards the player with one of the eight required Skell License Certificates. After completing this mission, the party obtains Skell Licenses, which permits them to buy and use Skells. The party also receives their first Skell, a US0220 Urban ST.
The Ties That Bind (Japanese: , Tatsu no Kazoku, Tatsu's Family) is an Affinity Mission in . It can be accepted on East Melville Street in the Commercial District.

The Matchmaker (Japanese: , Kokoro no Hatten, Emotional Development) is an Affinity Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received at the intersection of Barista Court and Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles. Completing it is a prerequisite for Chapter 8.
Thomas is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found in front of East Gate in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.

The Thieving Dilus (Japanese: , Robu Kurogosu) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Dilus family. It must be defeated at level 15 in Noctilum's Rust Lake during A New Rival?.

The Miracle Maker (Japanese: , Kiseki no Mizu, Miracle Water) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Staccata at the Cathedral in the Residential District of New Los Angeles.
Thug Caecuses (Japanese: , Sagu Doren) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caecus family, and can be found at level 12-13 in Cauldros, north of FN Site 502.

The Nopon Heir (Japanese: , Mira no Shugosha, The Protector of Mira) is an Affinity Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received near L's shop on Armory Alley in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.
